meta_description: Mosaic Electrical offers trusted, fully qualified electrical services across Manchester. From rewires to consumer units, get a free quote today. Call 07477 194708.
hero_eyebrow: NICEIC Registered Electrician — Free Quotes Available
hero_subhead: Electrical problems can't wait — Mosaic Electrical delivers safe, expert solutions across Manchester, when you need them most.
services_subhead: From minor repairs and fault finding to full rewires and EV charger installation, Mosaic Electrical covers every electrical need for homes and businesses throughout Manchester.

services.title: Full & Partial Rewires
services.desc: Outdated wiring is a serious safety risk. We carry out full and partial rewires to modern standards, leaving your property safe, certified, and compliant.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: An old fuse board can be a fire hazard and may not meet current regulations. We replace and upgrade consumer units quickly, with a full inspection certificate issued on completion.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Tripping circuits, dead sockets, or flickering lights? We use professional diagnostic equipment to pinpoint faults fast and carry out lasting repairs — not temporary fixes.

services.title: Lighting Installation
services.desc: Whether you want LED downlights, garden lighting, or a full lighting redesign, we install all types of domestic and commercial lighting with a clean, professional finish.

services.title: EV Charger Installation
services.desc: Making the switch to electric? We install home and workplace EV charging points to OZEV-approved standards, ensuring safe, efficient charging every time.

services.title: Electrical Inspections & Testing
services.desc: EICR condition reports, PAT testing, and landlord certificates issued by a fully qualified electrician. Stay compliant and protect your tenants, staff, and property.

about_pullquote: We do the job right the first time — every single time.
about_para_1: Mosaic Electrical was founded in Manchester with a straightforward mission: to provide reliable, high-quality electrical work that homeowners and businesses can genuinely trust. Based in Moston and serving the wider Manchester area, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time, backed by full qualifications and industry accreditation.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is the care we take on every job — no cutting corners, no mess left behind, and no bill that surprises you. Our customers return to us again and again because they know the work will be done safely, on time, and to a standard they're proud to show off.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About Mosaic Electrical

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. Turned up on time, explained everything clearly, and the consumer unit upgrade was done cleanly and professionally. Couldn't recommend Mosaic Electrical highly enough.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Had a persistent fault that two other electricians couldn't sort. Mosaic found and fixed it within an hour. Honest, knowledgeable, and great value. Will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: Karen B.

reviews.text: Got my EV charger installed last month — really tidy work, no fuss, and the price quoted was exactly what I paid. Really refreshing to deal with a tradesperson you can trust. Brilliant.
reviews.author: Darren H.
